name: Doctor Voldritch's Experiment
source:
It seems you signed up for an experiment at a lab testing the effects of mind control. The experiment is led by a rather calm yet eccentric doctor named Voldritch who will help you through the experiment and ease your mind leaving you, well, mindless.

[From [url=https://bloofbloof.itch.io/drvoldritch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
看来，你报名参加了实验室的一项实验，测试精神控制的效果。主持实验的是一位名叫沃尔德里奇的博士，他相当沉着，却又有些古怪。他会引导你完成实验，让你的心神放松，直到你……嗯，什么都不再想。

[摘自[url=https://bloofbloof.itch.io/drvoldritch]itch.io[/url]]
